title: Flirting
summary: Flirting is playful behaviour that shows romantic or sexual interest — light teasing, compliments, smiling, eye contact. Good flirting reads the other person and backs off if they aren't interested.
answer_guidance: Keep it light, practical and encouraging. Define slang plainly and give realistic tips; avoid gender stereotypes.
